findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_device_command, diagnose, list_device_commands, search_nomid_site, get_portal_link, propose_policy_change, read_company_chats, read_flagged_chats · Private data: list_companies, send_destructive_command, count_devices, diagnose, get_device, list_device_commands, read_device_document, search_devices, search_library, propose_policy_change, get_policy_document, get_policy_revision_document, create_provisioning_qr_code, read_company_chats, read_flagged_chats · Public sink: send_device_command, send_destructive_command, list_device_commands, propose_policy_change · Destructive: send_destructive_command, diagnose, list_device_commands, propose_policy_change, create_policy, create_provisioning_qr_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_device_command, diagnose, list_device_commands, search_nomid_site, get_portal_link, propose_policy_change, read_company_chats, read_flagged_chats · Private data: list_companies, send_destructive_command, count_devices, diagnose, get_device, list_device_commands, read_device_document, search_devices, search_library, propose_policy_change, get_policy_document, get_policy_revision_document, create_provisioning_qr_code, read_company_chats, read_flagged_chats · Public sink: send_device_command, send_destructive_command, list_device_commands, propose_policy_change · Destructive: send_destructive_command, diagnose, list_device_commands, propose_policy_change, create_policy, create_provisioning_qr_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
